question: Among superheroes with missing weight data and green skin, find the full name of the one with the highest strength attribute. Also, report how many more Marvel-published than DC-published heroes exist in this same group.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_018, s.XCL_020, p.XCL_015
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN colour AS c ON s.XCL_024 = c.XCL_005
  JOIN publisher AS p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
  WHERE s.XCL_029 IS NULL AND c.XCL_006 = 'Green'
),
best AS (
  SELECT e.XCL_020
  FROM eligible AS e
  JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON e.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
  JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
  WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
  ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT b.XCL_020,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_015 = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM best AS b
CROSS JOIN eligible AS e

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_018, s.XCL_020, p.XCL_015
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN colour AS c ON s.XCL_024 = c.XCL_005
  JOIN publisher AS p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
  WHERE s.XCL_029 IS NULL AND c.XCL_006 = 'Green'
),
best AS (
  SELECT e.XCL_020
  FROM eligible AS e
  JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON e.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
  JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
  WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
  ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT b.XCL_020,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_015 = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM best AS b
CROSS JOIN eligible AS e

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_018, s.XCL_020, p.XCL_015
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN colour AS c ON s.XCL_024 = c.XCL_005
  JOIN publisher AS p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
  WHERE s.XCL_029 IS NULL AND c.XCL_006 = 'Green'
),
best AS (
  SELECT e.XCL_020
  FROM eligible AS e
  JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON e.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
  JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
  WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
  ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT b.XCL_020,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_015 = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM best AS b
CROSS JOIN eligible AS e
